# pc_simulator_win_codeblocks
PC simulator project for LittlevGL embedded GUI Library for Windows in Codeblocks

This requires the MinGW version of **CodeBlocks 20.03 or newer** to be installed.

## How to use this:

It is recommended to run on the x86 windows 11 operating system, using CodeBlocks.

### Here are some tips for using this project:
1 Dowmload the Zip on your machine.
2 Open the LittlevGL.cbp choosing Codeblocks.
3 Build and run.

The main body of the project is placed in the folder named lv_mainstart, where you can discover lv_mainstart.c. You can modify the values of the valuable and redefine some functions.


Now,the project is just a test version which may have some errors and we will continue to advance this project. 

## This project is based on the LVGL V8.3.
